column1: # Lines for the cards whose kanji do not explain them.
# A card whose prompt has kanji shows what each kanji means, put together from kanji.tsv: 出口 shows
# "出 go out  口 opening". Where that line would mislead, or explain nothing, a row here replaces it.
# The meanings rest on KANJIDIC and JMdict (both: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, CC BY-SA 4.0).
# prompt: the prompt of the card in decks/signs.tsv, exactly.
# parts: the line to show instead, in the same form, at most 54 letters wide (a Japanese character counts as 2).
#        Kanji that form a word inside the word may stand together. Every kanji must occur in the prompt.
#        A line of the screen holds 27 letters: no piece between two double spaces may be wider, or it is cut off.
#        "普通 ordinary: one word" is for a word that its kanji do not explain even in groups.
#        empty: the card shows no line.
# reason: why the line from kanji.tsv was not kept.
# Rows stand in the order of the deck. A line that is only rough stays as it is: a row is for a line that
# sends the learner the wrong way or tells nothing.

column2: parts
column3: reason
One kanji is the whole word: the line would repeat the meaning.

column2: 普通 ordinary: one word
column3: 通 pass through misleads: this train stops at every station.

column2: 自由 freedom  席 seat
column3: 自 self and 由 reason do not add up to 自由, freedom.

column2: 指定 assigned  席 seat
column3: 指 point and 定 fix are far from a seat with a number; 指定 is assignment.

column2: 優先 priority  席 seat
column3: 優 superior and 先 ahead read like a better seat; 優先 is priority.

column2: 運転 running  見合わせ suspended
column3: The four kanji in a row say nothing; the two words do.

column2: 本日 today  休 rest  業 business
column3: 本 present can be read as a gift; 本日 is today.

column2: 貸 lend  切 completely
column3: 切 after a verb is to do completely (JMdict 切る, 貸し切る), not to cut.

column2: 割 one tenth  引 take away
column3: 割 is a tenth and 引 to deduct (JMdict 割, 引く); proportion and pull tell nothing.

column2: 品 goods  切 run out
column3: 切 is to run out (JMdict 切れる); cut reads like a cut price.

column2: 撮影 photography  禁止 prohibited
column3: 影 shadow misleads; 撮影 is photography.

column2: 立入 entering  禁止 prohibited
column3: 立 stand misleads: the sign is about going in, not about standing.

column2: 売 sell  切 run out
column3: 切 is to run out (JMdict 切れる); sell and cut read like a sale.

column2: 替 exchange  玉 ball of noodles
column3: 玉 is a portion of noodles here (JMdict 玉); ball alone tells nothing.

column2: 食 eat  放題 as you like
column3: 放 set free and 題 topic mislead; 放題 is a word: as one pleases.

column2: 飲 drink  放題 as you like
column3: 放 set free and 題 topic mislead; 放題 is a word: as one pleases.
通 pass through says nothing about a dish, and JMdict has the word only whole.
